# openwrt_file (Ephemeral Resource)

Reads a file from the router without storing it in plan or state (Terraform/OpenTofu >= 1.10). Feed it into write-only attributes of other resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read a secret generated on the router without persisting it anywhere.
ephemeral "openwrt_file" "wg_key" {
  path = "/etc/wireguard/wg0.key"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String)

### Read-Only

- `content` (String, Sensitive)
- `content_base64` (String, Sensitive)
